conviction_note: Scaled number is (2*0.53-1)*12.5 = +0.75. The abs move is anchored on the indicative 14.3% option-implied move (ATM spread 57% of mid) and the 12.4% median of seven prints. The findings sum to +0.3: a NanoKnife Medicare tailwind that sits inside the guide, a record of conservative guiding, and small Med Device and AngioVac drags. p_up stays near 50 because this name sold two clean beat-and-raise quarters for -13.5% and -13.7% and paid only +1.7% for an 8% revenue beat with a guide set above consensus.

Earnings Whispers (https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/w/ANGO) gives -$0.10 / $80.94m and an aggregator search snippet gives -$0.10 / $79.48m, so two sources roughly agree. positioning_check: Short interest is 1,343,344 shares, 3.46% of float, 3.5 days to cover, at the 2026-09-15 settlement, down 1.48% from the prior period (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/ANGO/short-interest/), so this is not a crowded short. The baseline has no 25-delta skew (null). Put/call OI ratio is 0.73 on total OI of 1,282. Run-up is -7.0% over 5 days and -6.7% over 20, 11% off the 52-week high, so some disappointment is pre-priced into the print.

findings.finding: Palmetto GBA's final LCD L40205 gives Medicare coverage for NanoKnife IRE in favorable-intermediate-risk prostate cancer and colorectal liver metastases, effective 2026-07-05. That puts fiscal Q1 FY27 (Jun-Aug 2026) as the first quarter with coverage. Hospitals kept launching prostate programs into June 2026, and NanoKnife grew 64.5% in FQ4 with probes up 47%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: NanoKnife +64.5% inside an 8% revenue beat with a guide above consensus bought +1.7% on 2026-07-14 (baseline). Med Tech double-digit growth beats were sold on 2026-01-06 (-13.5%) and 2026-04-02 (-13.7%).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The LCD was final before the July 14 guide, so the Med Tech +12-15% guide already contains it. What is not visible is the size of the first coverage quarter in probes. If the market had priced an acceleration, consensus would sit above the guide arithmetic (~$80.5m) rather than on it, and the stock would not be -7% into the print.
findings.independence: Hospital launches are an anecdotal proxy (UnityPoint St. Luke's, June 2026: https://www.unitypoint.org/news-and-articles/press-releases/unitypoint-health-st-lukes-first-in-metro-to-offer-new-minimally-invasive-prostate-cancer-treatment). The FQ4 NanoKnife figures come from the 8-K exhibit that finding 2 also uses.

findings.finding: Management has under-guided and then beaten consistently. FY26 guidance was raised in Q1, Q2 and Q3, and revenue beat consensus in FQ1 FY26 ($75.7m vs $72.7m), FQ3 ($78.4m vs $76.8m) and FQ4 ($86.6m vs $80.2m). The FY27 revenue guide of $336-341m was set about $24.5m above consensus, while the CFO said on the July call that Q1 normally steps down from Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Beat-and-raise quarters gave +6.1% (2025-10-02, Q1 raise), -13.5% (2026-01-06, Q2 raise), -13.7% (2026-04-02, Q3 raise) and +1.7% (2026-07-14, guide above consensus). This name has mostly not paid for raises.
findings.why_not_priced: The beat habit is public, and the whisper (-$0.06 vs -$0.10) shows the buy side expects it. A FY27 raise in Q1 is not in consensus, which sits on the guide. If it were priced, the stock would not have drifted -7% in the week into the print.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers whisper -$0.06 vs -$0.10 consensus (https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/w/ANGO). Shares the FY26 releases with finding 1.

findings.finding: AngioVac revenue fell 15.8% to $6.9m in FQ4 on competitive intensity, which left mechanical thrombectomy at -1.1% despite AlphaVac +38.4%. The competitor Penumbra then grew global thrombectomy 12.5% in Apr-Jun 2026 (reported 2026-07-30, after ANGO last spoke), so the share pressure on AngioVac probably continued into FQ1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No print has been identifiably traded on thrombectomy alone. FQ4's -1.1% thrombectomy sat inside a +1.7% reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the FQ4 decline was disclosed. AngioVac is about 8% of revenue, and it sits inside a Med Tech +12-15% guide that NanoKnife and Auryon carry. Net of the rest of Med Tech, only a deeper slide moves the total.
findings.independence: Penumbra Q2 2026 release (https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/penumbra-inc-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results) is a competitor proxy, not an ANGO number.

findings.finding: For the first time in at least ten years, ANGO did not file its definitive proxy by late September (DEF 14A every year 2016-2025, the latest 2025-09-25). It filed a 10-K/A with Part III on 2026-09-29 'because we may not file a definitive proxy statement ... within 120 days.' The CEO is retiring at the earlier of 2026-11-30 or a successor's appointment, and management expected the successor in the first half of FY27. A successor announcement alongside the print is plausible and has no clear sign.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None. The retirement was announced 2026-02-03 between prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody aggregates a proxy-timing break. But the inference that a CEO name or another event is imminent is unconfirmed, and the explanatory note gives no reason, so the expected value is zero with width.
findings.independence: DEF 14A history on EDGAR (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001275187&type=DEF+14A). CEO transition per the 10-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001275187/000162828026048138/ango-20260531.htm). Both are the company's own documents.

findings.finding: Class 2 recall of SoftVu and AccuVu diagnostic catheters (Z-1866-2026 to Z-1874-2026, worldwide distribution, 65-5,155 units per recall number), initiated 2026-03-03 and posted 2026-04-17. This is a small Med Device headwind that may persist into FQ1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None identifiable. It fell in FQ4, which still beat and reacted +1.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since April and small against a Med Device line guided flat; FQ4 Med Device still grew 1.1%. It matters only if the replacement supply lagged.

outside_window.finding: The CEO must retire by 2026-11-30 if no successor is named. The annual meeting is reported for 2026-11-10 (aggregator). A successor announcement outside the print day would land after the window.

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR since the 2026-07-14 8-K: no 8-K, no S-3/ATM, no new financing. The only filings are routine July Form 4s (M-exempt vestings plus one director sale on 2026-07-30) and the two Part III 10-K/As
10-K FY26 for IEEPA tariff refund disclosure: none. Tariffs were a $4.8m FY26 headwind, guided 'broadly similar' for FY27, with no refund receivable disclosed
Strategic alternatives, activist or takeover news: none found. Boston Scientific's pending acquisition of Penumbra is sector M&A context, not an ANGO event
FDA 510(k) or new recalls after April 2026: none found beyond the March 2026 catheter recall
Company press releases Aug-Sep 2026 other than the earnings date notice: none found
Analyst actions after July 2026: none found (July targets Canaccord $20, HCW $19)
Reason for the -7% five-day drawdown: no company-specific cause found (worth 0 per rule)

baseline_tension: A mild positive lean against a -7% five-day drawdown with no skew reading. The findings do not contradict the run-up, which has no identifiable cause, and they are too small to argue that the market is wrong.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction; this name sold two beat-and-raise quarters by about 13.5%): beat/guide-conservatism finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3 and p_up from 54 to 53

Rule 6 (inside the guide): the NanoKnife coverage finding lands inside the Med Tech +12-15% guide set after the LCD was final, cut from +0.6 to +0.4. The recall sits inside a flat Med Device guide, cut from -0.2 to -0.1
Rule 9 (segment net of the rest): AngioVac is about 8% of revenue, offset by AlphaVac +38% and NanoKnife/Auryon; cut from -0.4 to -0.3
Rule 6 (bar): two roughly agreeing estimate sources plus the guide arithmetic, so no cap applied
Rule 7: short interest checked at 3.46% / 3.5 days, not crowded; no skew available; nothing changed
Rule 8 and the core's understatement note: abs_move_pct kept at 12.5 rather than shrunk
